profile.name: Xinyi Fu
profile.position: Associate Professor, The Future Laboratory, Tsinghua University
bio: I am an Associate Research Professor at the Future Laboratory, Tsinghua University. I received my Ph.D. in Design from the Academy of Arts & Design, Tsinghua University, in 2018, and my B.S. degree in Computer Science and Technology from Tsinghua University in 2012.

I lead the Sensing and AI-Engaged Living Lab (SNAIL Lab), which focuses on multimodal sensing, computing, and interaction in intelligent spaces. Our research explores key topics including multimodal behavior computing, affective computing, AI-driven decision-making, embodied interaction, and human–AI trust. We aim to establish an integrated sensing–reasoning-interaction framework for human–environment collaboration, enabling intelligent environments to continuously perceive human states, understand cognitive and psychological needs, and proactively interact with users in a natural and adaptive manner. Our research contributes to a broad range of domains, including smart homes, digital mental health, embodied intelligence, and future living environments.
